Puppy pose with some adoptable pups! Take a class and maybe take home a furry friend!

About this Event

⭐️BYOM: Bring Your Own Mat or Rent One for $5⭐️

Puppy pose with us @ Stick around after for some Drinks & Brunch!
Class starts at 10:30am, be sure to arrive 10-15 minutes early to settle in!
✨All Ages Welcome✨
The lesson is 45 minutes long with lots of puppy love. You will have time after class to take the perfect pictures, play and fill out paperwork if you find a new family member at class!
No Posing or Adoptions Necessary, Just Come Support!

Join us where your joy helps rescue & rehabilitate animals in need, while finding them fosters & forever homes!

Just give your full name at the door! After you’ve purchased your name will be added to the class list!
